component.name: DetailScene
component.script:
sub init() m.bg = m.top.findNode("bg") m.poster = m.top.findNode("poster") m.titleLbl = m.top.findNode("titleLbl") m.descLbl = m.top.findNode("descLbl") m.playBtn = m.top.findNode("playBtn") m.backBtn = m.top.findNode("backBtn")
m.top.observeField("boundingRect", "onResize") onResize()
m.playBtn.observeField("buttonSelected", "onPlay") m.backBtn.observeField("buttonSelected", "onBack")
m.top.observeField("content", "onContentChanged")
' Ensure remote works immediately m.playBtn.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onResize() if m.top.width <= 0 or m.top.height <= 0 then return m.bg.width = m.top.width m.bg.height = m.top.height end sub
sub onContentChanged() item = m.top.content if item = invalid then m.titleLbl.text = "No item" m.descLbl.text = "" return end if
' Poster if item.fhdPosterUrl <> invalid and item.fhdPosterUrl <> "" m.poster.uri = item.fhdPosterUrl else if item.hdPosterUrl <> invalid and item.hdPosterUrl <> "" m.poster.uri = item.hdPosterUrl else m.poster.uri = "https://frontdoormedia.org/images/posters/fd_poster_01.jpg" end if
' Text m.titleLbl.text = item.title if item.description <> invalid and item.description <> "" m.descLbl.text = item.description else m.descLbl.text = item.shortDescriptionLine1 end if
m.playBtn.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onPlay() item = m.top.content if item = invalid or item.url = invalid or item.url = "" then m.descLbl.text = "Missing video URL." return end if
player = CreateObject("roSGNode", "PlayerScene") player.content = item
if m.playerScene <> invalid m.top.removeChild(m.playerScene) end if
m.playerScene = player m.top.appendChild(m.playerScene) m.playerScene.setFocus(true)
m.playerScene.observeField("closeRequested", "onPlayerClose") end sub
sub onPlayerClose() if m.playerScene <> invalid m.top.removeChild(m.playerScene) m.playerScene = invalid m.playBtn.setFocus(true) end if end sub
sub onBack() ' Toggle so observers fire every time m.top.closeRequested = not m.top.closeRequested end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false
if key = "back" onBack() return true end if
return false end function
